line: update v0.4.3: separate rush periods, advanced fares, caribbean!

items.text: added shift click on a station while editing a line's stops, to make trains stop there going one way only
items.edited: added shift click on a station to specify a one-way stop

items.text: added a choice to name stations after their complex or give each its own name
items.edited: added choice to unpin station names from the name of their station complex

items.text: added snapping to freight and abandoned rail in the real world network's All setting
fixed stop edits being lost when stop editing was ended before a slow game had applied them
items.edited: fixed stop edits being lost, when stop editing mode was exited before the changes were saved

items.text: fixed trips home paying for a change of trains the trip out never made
added a speed limit to the Select tool's bar, set on all the selected track at once
items.edited: unified track controls / rebuilds to the top bar, out of the track view

items.text: fixed demand bubbles staying on screen in Safari after turning them off
added 4 and 5 service periods (rush, or morning and afternoon apart), set for the whole game or per line in the schedule window
items.edited: set 4 or 5 service periods, to split morning / midday / afternoon rush!

items.text: fixed locals leaving a passing station just before the express passed them
added advanced fares, opened from the money tab: the fare curve can have up to 12 points, so fares can go up in steps, and every country's fares are in one list
items.edited: added advanced fare panel, allows adding additional points to fare curve

items.text: real world stations show as rings on top of blueprints and track
items.edited: real world stations show as rings on top of blueprints and track while placing stations

items.text: shared network links show a picture of the network when pasted into chats and social sites
fixed deleting a game with a small newest version asking no typed station count when a bigger version is under it, and deleting one big version asking none
items.edited: fixed deleting a big game without typing its station count when a smaller version was on top

items.text: fixed the city you're looking at on a big save sometimes showing no train trips for minutes while the game loads
items.edited: faster demand loading for the focused city

items.text: fixed long games using more memory every game day; past about 2 years, money history older than 4 months is kept by month, so a 50 year game uses 1 GB less memory
items.edited: fixed long games using more memory every game day, so a 50 year game uses 1 GB less memory

items.text: added fare zones: paint stations into numbered fare zones from the advanced fares panel, and a trip within one fare area pays by the fare zones it spans

added Cuba, the Dominican Republic, Haiti, Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, the Bahamas, Barbados, Saint Lucia, Curaçao, Grenada, Saint Vincent, Aruba, Antigua, Dominica, the Cayman Islands, Bolivia and Paraguay
items.edited: added most of the caribbean, bolivia and paraguay!

items.text: added real world network starts for nagoya, fukuoka, sapporo and hiroshima
added a setting to use the old time speed buttons
fixed a save that fails to open leaving you in a new empty game; you now go back to the menu and the save is left as it was
items.edited: fixed a save that fails to open leaving you in a new empty game

items.text: if calculating trips gets stuck while a game loads, it now restarts once before showing an error
fixed a crash at startup when the browser drops the graphics while the game is still loading
fixed the memory shown in settings reading far above what the game uses when more than one demand worker runs
fixed a renamed station showing its old name at some zoom levels
fixed trips between cities paying the wrong fare on a bent fare curve
flat junctions and crossings no line uses no longer show a mark
fixed a second tab with the same game open being unable to go back to the main menu, even with nothing changed in it
fixed track ending just short of a bare track end being refused as too tight
a copy of a shared network that you keep playing now shows Copy when shared, not Sandbox
